meta.description: Character LoRA on IllustriousXL (SDXL arch). Point model.name_or_path at your local Illustrious checkpoint if you have one. Use booru-style tag captions with a unique trigger tag first. automagic3 variant: the LR above is a launch point, not a target - the optimizer adapts one LR per param group from gradient sign consensus, so no scheduler is needed. min_lr/max_lr rail it (max_lr = this preset's own LR, so it can only adapt downward). Gradient accumulation MUST stay 1 unless you also set optimizer_params.fused=false: fused automagic steps every micro-batch and the trainer hard-errors at config parse otherwise. UNVERIFIED for this arch - automagic3 has no published per-arch data; Krea 2 is the only arch in this fork with a real measured run. Speed (2026-08-29): latents are served from RAM after the first pass (cache_latents + cache_latents_to_disk — disk-only caching re-read every latent every step), loss_sync_every 4, ui_db_poll_seconds 2. Training math unchanged. STEP TABLE (meta.step_table, 2026-10-12, evidence-based Illustrious/NoobAI table, machine-independent - the same table ships on every IllustriousXL and SDXL preset, laptop or desktop, character or style): 20 images ~1600, 30 images ~2000, 40 images ~2500, 50 images ~3000, exact-count interpolation between rows, capped at 3000 steps. OPTIMIZED DATASET COUNT ~50 images: that is where the cap is reached; past it the panel keeps 3000 and the exposure gauge says the dataset is past the optimal size for this model and suggests curating down, instead of calling it undertrained. Sources: character LoRAs converge at a roughly fixed ~1500-2000 total steps (Illustrious kohya guide, civitai.com/models/850658: ~1500 steps per character; DCAI Illustrious and NoobAI character guides: 1600 steps; civitai.com/articles/21604 NoobAI: 1900-2000; civitai.com/articles/9148: 2500-3000 at lower LR), style LoRAs want ~3000 steps on ~50 images (civitai.com/articles/25645), and 20-30 images 2000-3000 (r/StableDiffusion primer). Values are steps at effective batch 1; the Step Suggestion panel divides by your effective batch (batch_size x gradient_accumulation), which is the only thing that differs between machines. Below the first row the first row's steps apply.
